title: Derived localizations on opens in the ambient Hom universe
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and suppose the localization defining $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] has morphisms in universe $w$. Then there exists a dependent family, over all open subsets $U$ of $X$, of chosen localizations of complexes of $\mathcal O_X|_U$-modules at quasi-isomorphisms whose morphisms also lie in universe $w$.

source.place: Tag 08BT, exact extension-by-zero/restriction derived adjunction; Mathlib HasDerivedCategory.standard and localization universal property

proof.text: First choose the standard derived localizations with their unrestricted Hom universe. Exact extension by zero and restriction induce a derived adjunction. The unit is an isomorphism because restriction of extension by zero is the identity, checked on stalks. Thus derived extension by zero is fully faithful.

Compare the ambient standard localization to the given ambient localization by the localization universal property. Full faithfulness identifies each Hom on U with a Hom in the given ambient category, hence makes it w-small. Replace each Hom by a w-small model and transport composition and identities along these bijections. Compose the standard localization functor with the resulting equivalence; it remains a localization. Choose these localizations simultaneously over all opens.
